question: 单项选择：By the time I got up, my mother _____ breakfast. A. cook  B. cooked  C. has cooked  D. had cooked
answer: 答案：D. had cooked。解析：By the time I got up（过去时），主句用过去完成时，表示"过去的过去"。整句：By the time I got up, my mother had cooked breakfast.

question: 单项选择：I _____ the film before, so I didn't want to see it again. A. see  B. saw  C. had seen  D. will see
answer: 答案：C. had seen。解析：I didn't want是一般过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (leave) before I arrived.
answer: 答案：had left。解析：before I arrived是过去时，从句用过去完成时。完整：She had left before I arrived.

question: 单项选择：When I _____ home, my father had already cooked dinner. A. get  B. got  C. have got  D. will get
answer: 答案：B. got。解析：When I got是一般过去时（参照点），主句用过去完成时had cooked（过去的过去）。

question: 翻译句子：我回到家时，我爸爸已经看完了报纸。
answer: 答案：When I got home, my father had already finished reading the newspaper. 解析：got是一般过去时，had finished是过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：He _____ English for ten years before he came to China. A. study  B. studied  C. has studied  D. had studied
answer: 答案：D. had studied。解析：before he came是过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：By the time he ______ (arrive), the train had already left.
answer: 答案：arrived。解析：By the time + 一般过去时，主句用过去完成时。完整：By the time he arrived, the train had already left.

question: 单项选择：I didn't know she _____ to Beijing. A. go  B. went  C. has gone  D. had gone
answer: 答案：D. had gone。解析：didn't know是一般过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 翻译句子：他告诉我说他已经完成了工作。
answer: 答案：He told me that he had finished his work. 解析：told是过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：The movie _____ already begun when we got to the cinema. A. start  B. started  C. has started  D. had started
answer: 答案：D. had started。解析：when we got是一般过去时，主句用过去完成时。
